name: IBM ACE
description: Manages IBM App Connect Enterprise servers and applications via the ACE REST API.

tools.name: list_servers
tools.documentation: Lists all IBM ACE integration servers with their name and state.

tools.name: start_server
tools.documentation: Starts a specific IBM ACE integration server.

tools.name: list_applications
tools.documentation: Lists all applications deployed on a specific IBM ACE integration server.

tools.name: start_application
tools.documentation: Starts a specific application on an IBM ACE integration server.

tools.name: stop_server
tools.documentation: Stops a specific IBM ACE integration server that is currently running.

tools.name: stop_application
tools.documentation: Stops a specific application running on an IBM ACE integration server.

tools.name: get_server_logs
tools.documentation: Retrieves the last 20 log entries from a specific IBM ACE integration server for monitoring and diagnostics.
